blocks.text:
Flick up on an app icon and a small panel opens over the Home screen - above the icon where there is room for it, below the icon near the top of the screen where there isn't.

The panel holds whatever that app has to offer right now. Music it is playing, with the artwork and previous, play and next. Its three most recent notifications, each one tapping straight through to the app. Up to four of its shortcuts, the same ones a long press offers. An app with none of those says so rather than opening an empty panel, and Open is always in the corner.

The gesture only claims a clear upward flick, so tapping, holding and swiping between pages carry on as they were. Music and notifications need notification access; the shortcuts do not.

Like every tweak it has its own page in Settings › Tweaks, with a switch for the cover screen and a switch for the inner one, so it can be on where it helps and off where it doesn't.

Inspired by Velox by Phillip Tennen. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.

items: Flick up on any Home screen icon
Play, pause and skip without opening the app
Up to four of its shortcuts
Open, above the icon or below it

entries.notes: Cabinet becomes a package in the Folio Market. The tweak itself has shipped with Folio since 0.6.0.
